rationale: MOD is trading at 1.4% above today's low after a massive gap-down (~8%) on an earnings miss, with price compressed near the session low and well below VWAP ($97.46) and the 9-EMA ($94.07), suggesting continued selling pressure. However, the stock has already fallen ~26% from yesterday's close to today's low, creating potential for a short-squeeze bounce, while the broader market is strongly up (SPY +1.81%, VIXY -9.27%), adding conflicting signals. With no clear directional edge — the downtrend is exhausted near lows but overhead supply is heavy — and given the wide spread, high volatility (ATR ~$1.17 on 5m bars), and an already-committed working order consuming buying power, the risk/reward is insufficient to justify a new position.
